name: Enerya Enerji Anonim Sirketi
summary: Enerya Enerji Anonim Sirketi, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the wholesale and retail distribution of natural gas in Turkey. The company also provides operational and consultancy services and is involved in the precious metals mining business. It serves residential and industrial customers. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey. Enerya Enerji Anonim Sirketi is a subsidiary of Ahlatci Dogal Gaz Dagitim Enerji ve Yatirim A.S.
